clarification: log10||A||F is a regularization diagnostic, not a quality score; faithfulness is evaluated separately.
Use I_C whenever the dimension is explicit; I is only shorthand for the C x C identity.
The real-data table reports the median across condition cells; the runtime table reports the mean across matrix-size and repeat runs.
pinv reciprocates nonzero singular values; ridge continuously damps all directions and makes Y^T W Y + lambda I_C strictly positive definite.
truncated SVD applies a hard cutoff; ridge uses the continuous filter s/(s^2+lambda).
delta is applied to row RMS input-space residuals, ||x_i-Ay_i||_2/sqrt(d), to permit cross-dataset comparison.
